name: At Vendetta's Close
description:
After so long, still she dreams of another possibility, a way she could have taken her vengeance. 
<Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery> Once fully charged, deals area True damage to both allies and enemies, centered on the friendly unit with the highest Block. 
Environmental Conditions: 
Touches of the Sanguinarch and Gifts of the Sanguinarch have increased ATK, and the DP cost of Defender Operators is increased.
